abstract: Two cases of mediastinal germ cell tumors associated with primary hemoproliferative disorders are reported. The first case was a 23-year-old man who presented simultaneously with a mediastinal immature teratoma with focal yolk sac differentiation and a cytologically benign histiocytic proliferation associated with refractory thrombocytopenia. In the second case, an unsuspected mediastinal immature teratoma with focal yolk sac and hepatic differentiation was found postmortem in a 33-year-old man who had died of fulminant malignant histiocytosis. Although the histiocytosis in the former case failed to fulfill all the usual diagnostic criteria of malignant histiocytosis, both cases probably represent different manifestations of the same pathologic process. Review of the 19 published cases of hematologic malignancies associated with mediastinal germ cell tumors and of related experimental studies suggests a role for yolk sac differentiation in the pathogenesis of this syndrome.
abstract_ja: 原発性血液増殖性疾患を伴う縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の2症例を報告する。1例目は23歳男性で、卵黄嚢分化巣を伴う縦隔未熟奇形腫と、細胞学的に良性の組織球増殖が同時に認められ、これは難治性血小板減少症に伴っていた。2例目は33歳男性で、卵黄嚢および肝分化を伴う縦隔未熟奇形腫が認識されないまま、劇症型悪性組織球症で死亡した後の剖検で発見された。前者の組織球症は悪性組織球症の通常の診断基準をすべては満たさなかったが、両症例は同一の病理学的過程の異なる表現型を示している可能性が高い。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に伴う血液悪性腫瘍の既報19例と関連する実験的研究の検討から、この症候群の病因に卵黄嚢分化が関与している可能性が示唆される。
